 11	// ViewContext renders the chat the way the model currently reads it: the
 12	// compaction summaries (detected by the SummaryLabel prefix) in order, then the
 13	// live tail that the summaries do not cover. A positive n caps the number of
 14	// summaries shown; a n <= 0 shows them all.
 15	//
 16	// The summaries and the live tail both live in the done/cur slots — the settled
 17	// history and the current turn. The system prompt, examples, and notes are
 18	// scaffolding the model reads every turn rather than history it is asked to
 19	// remember, so they are not part of this view.
 20	//
 21	// /tokens says how full the window is and the transcript says what was actually
 22	// said; what neither shows is the fold — the thing the model sees — which is
 23	// the niche this command fills. It is deliberately a single mode: the fold is
 24	// the fold, there is no second half to hide.
 25	func (c *Coder) ViewContext(n int) string {
 26		chunks := c.formatMessages()
 27	
 28		var summaries []llm.Message
 29		var tail []llm.Message
 30		for _, m := range chunks.done {
 31			if isSummaryMessage(m) {
 32				summaries = append(summaries, m)
 33			} else {
 34				tail = append(tail, m)
 35			}
 36		}
 37		tail = append(tail, chunks.cur...)
 38	
 39		var b strings.Builder
 40		b.WriteString("Context as the model sees it:\n")
 41	
 42		if len(summaries) == 0 {
 43			b.WriteString("No compaction summaries; the whole history is the live tail.\n")
 44		} else if n > 0 && n < len(summaries) {
 45			word := "summaries"
 46			if n == 1 {
 47				word = "summary"
 48			}
 49			b.WriteString("first " + strconv.Itoa(n) + " of " + strconv.Itoa(len(summaries)) + " " +
 50				word + " shown.\n")
 51		}
 52	
 53		shown := summaries
 54		if n > 0 && n < len(summaries) {
 55			shown = summaries[:n]
 56		}
 57		for _, s := range shown {
 58			b.WriteString(s.Text())
 59			b.WriteString("\n")
 60		}
 61	
 62		if len(tail) > 0 {
